innovation1_extraction.scope: four-task shared-M algorithms only; no old runner, approvals, weights, optimizer or results
innovation1_extraction.training: new local CLI functional training, not historical recipe reproduction

simon_scalar.modifications: Locally reimplemented scalar SIMON64/128 block encryption and round-key prefix; omitted RoundTrace, trace_simon64, and simulator APIs; no old runtime imports.

innovation2_ste_simon.scope: hard Boolean forward with TRAIN-only sigmoid surrogate gradients and Adam; no solver/enumeration/actual key initialization

innovation2_sat_simon.scope: new public DAG CNF, one TRAIN-only Glucose4 fit with cooperative interrupt; no archived solver or actual key injection

innovation2_hard_simon.scope: new TRAIN-only integer-bitparallel unknown-effect fitting; no archived solver/runner or actual secret injection

innovation2_structured_simon.scope: public output-cone model learning unknown constants; allowed structure prior without actual key input, not yet scientifically fitted

innovation2_structure_diagnostic.scope: artificial CPU structure-vs-random comparison and public symbolic SIMON cone compiler; no new cipher fitting

innovation2_logic_candidate.scope: new pure-Torch soft truth-table candidate and synthetic controls, no new scientific cipher fitting

innovation2_prediction.scope: new plaintext support/direct/public-residual predictor; no historical checkpoints, solver or runner
innovation2_prediction.labels: data/prediction.py separates unique plaintexts from actual or null labels; key exists only in label generation

dataset_panel_limitation.policy: Legacy make_simon/make_synthetic APIs still materialize all labels; prediction training now constructs plaintext identities first and requests TEST labels only after strict selected-checkpoint load. Innovation1 still prebuilds split labels.
dataset_panel_limitation.limitation: The test split is not an audit-equivalent sealed confirm set: generation exposes all panels to the caller at once, and no access-control or evaluation-freeze boundary is implemented.
